title: Retain conflicting disk-role evidence without selecting a winner

items.request.record-evidence: The caller asks to record new disk-role evidence
items.target.hint.n5-tank-fourth-disk: Plain-language target hints for N5, tank, and the fourth migration disk
items.evidence.new-disk-role: A new source says the disk has already joined tank
items.evidence.new-source-time: The new source includes time and scope
items.lookup.disk-role-context: A bounded request for identities, competing claims, and safety conditions
items.store.claim.independent-source: Existing sourced material says the disk is still independent
items.store.safety.require-role-and-verificati: Destructive reuse requires disk role and verification to be established
items.coverage.context-complete: The requested competing context was fully searched
items.meaning.unresolved-conflict: The two sources cover the same role but do not establish one winner
items.proposal.retain-new-source: Proposed retention of the new source
items.proposal.record-resolution-question: Proposed question describing evidence that could resolve the conflict
items.result.conflict-recorded: The durable side reports the conflict effects as applied
items.durable.conflict.disk-role: Discoverable conflict between the two interpretations
items.durable.question.resolve-disk-role: A stored unresolved question, not an observation
items.response.conflict-and-blocker: The caller receives the conflict, stored safety blocker, and needed observation

steps.note: Send the new source, claimed meaning, time, scope, and target hints
Request resolved identities, competing material, and any applicable safety condition
Return identities, the older claim, the safety condition, and search coverage
Preserve both interpretations and a resolution question without inventing a winner
Retain the source, competing interpretation, conflict, and unresolved question
Return the unresolved conflict and the already stored destructive-action blocker
